A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DC-AE research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated content.

before.justification: v3 reports original reconstruction, generation, efficiency and ablation results in Tables 1–5 and the accompanying figures and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original DC-AE experiments and adds USiT generation results and additional ImageNet evaluation metrics in Tables 3 and 6.

M1.justification: Section 4.1 introduces USiT by combining UViT with the SiT sampler, adding a diffusion-sampling adaptation. DC-AE's residual autoencoding, architecture components and three-phase adaptation procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The ImageNet, SAM, FFHQ, MJHQ and MapillaryVistas coverage and reconstruction, conditional generation, unconditional generation and text-to-image tasks are retained. USiT and the additional metrics use the existing ImageNet 512×512 task.

E2.justification: Table 3 substantially broadens comparisons beyond autoencoder alternatives by adding MAGVIT-v2, EDM2-XXL and MAR-L as whole-model generation comparators. Table 6 additionally evaluates Flux-VAE-f8 with UViT-2B. The existing UViT-S comparator set is retained in the appendix.

E3.justification: Appendix D expands ImageNet generation quality evaluation from FID to include Inception Score, precision, recall and CMMD, substantially broadening the evaluation endpoints. USiT-H and USiT-2B introduce additional model/sampler configurations. Previously stated splits, training budgets and efficiency-profiling assumptions remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The residual-autoencoding, resolution-adaptation, GAN-refinement and patch-size analyses, scaling plot and qualitative examples are retained. Figure 9 is relocated. Table 6 supplies additional benchmark metrics without introducing a new ablation, robustness test or error analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for these experiments. The additional metrics in v4 are performance measures, not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 3 and 6 add USiT results, including guided FIDs of 1.89 and 1.72, new comparator results and four additional metrics across ImageNet comparisons. UViT-S/Asym-VAE FIDs without/with CFG change from 51.96/24.57 to 52.68/25.14. Table 6 reports DiT-XL/Asym-VAE FIDs of 11.39/2.97, conflicting with 11.55/2.95 retained in Table 3. UViT-S training-throughput, latency and memory entries are omitted.

T1.justification: The space/channel transformations and shortcut equations in Section 3.2 are unchanged. No new formal assumptions, theorems, proofs or mathematical definitions accompany the additional experiments or metrics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same central claims: two DC-AE techniques, spatial compression up to 128 and faster diffusion generation with maintained quality. The added experimental comparisons do not revise these core statements.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 changes the scaling example from UViT-H to UViT-2B, aligning it with the unguided-FID crossing in Figure 9. Appendix D newly interprets the additional metrics as supporting preserved generation quality. The optimization and generalization explanations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Hardware, software, precision and profiling details in Section 4.1, the UViT-2B architecture specification in Appendix B and the code-access link remain unchanged. The USiT addition identifies a method combination without providing further implementation settings or reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: v4 adds references for SiT, EDM2, MAGVIT-v2, MAR and evaluation metrics. Section 4.3 adds positioning against leading diffusion and autoregressive generators. The related-work narrative and claimed novelty of high spatial-compression autoencoders remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds a short USiT description, a generation-comparison paragraph and Appendix D, and refines the scaling discussion and cross-references. Most prose and the existing section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Table 3 is reorganized, with UViT-S comparisons transferred to the new dense Table 6. Figure 9 moves from page 9 to page 8 and is resized. Table 5 now shares a page with Table 6. Existing plots and sample images are retained.

improvement.justification: The additional metrics make generation quality and efficiency easier to assess beyond v3's FID-focused ImageNet evaluation, and the revised scaling example better matches Figure 9. Broader comparisons provide useful context. These gains are limited by sparse USiT/comparator protocol documentation, omitted UViT-S efficiency entries and the new Asym-VAE FID inconsistency between Tables 3 and 6.
